description: Secondary pages (Trips, Notifications, Profile, Settings), accessibility pass, responsive refinement, visual polish, and final build verification. Depends on FEAT-001 (design tokens), FEAT-002 (authStore cleanup), FEAT-003 (shared UI components). Independent of FEAT-004 (different pages).
steps: 1. Read apps/web/src/pages/TripsPage.tsx in full. Apply white background. Keep all data-fetching logic (apiClient.getTrips() for auth users). Guest empty state: EmptyState component (icon=Map, heading='Sign in to view your trips', body='Save and sync your trip plans across devices.', ctaLabel='Sign In', onCta=openAuthModal). Authenticated+empty state: EmptyState(icon=Map, heading='No trips planned yet.', body='Explore parks and plan your perfect visit.', ctaLabel='Plan a Visit', onCta=()=>navigate('/app/plan')). Trip cards: white qc-card-white-interactive, park name in navy, date in slate-600, days-away chip in blue, crowd badge, ticket price in blue-600. Upcoming/Past grouping preserved. Delete button preserved. Desktop: 2-column grid for trip cards (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2). Loading state uses SkeletonCard. Error state uses ErrorState.

2. Read apps/web/src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx in full. Apply white background. Remove the fake notifications that were in authStore (done in FEAT-002) — this page already correctly fetches from apiClient.getNotifications() for auth users and uses local state. Guest empty state (sessionType !== 'authenticated'): EmptyState(icon=Bell, heading='Sign in for personalized alerts', body='Receive crowd alerts, weather updates, and pricing notifications for your favorite parks.'). Authenticated+empty: EmptyState(icon=BellOff, heading="You're all caught up.", body='No notifications right now.'). Loading: SkeletonCard×3. Error: ErrorState. Filter tabs: white/blue styling. Notification cards: white, unread = left blue border, read = normal. Mark-all-read button preserved.

3. Read apps/web/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx in full. Apply white background. Guest state: EmptyState with Sign In CTA. Auth state: white profile header card — avatar circle (real image or initials fallback in blue), name in navy h1, email in slate-500, location/member-since chips in slate-100/slate-600. Stats row: 3 white cards (Trips count, Parks visited count — real from savedTrips). Menu list: white rows with chevron, hover:bg-slate-50. Sign Out button at bottom in red text. All navigation logic preserved.

4. Read apps/web/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx in full. Apply white background. Sections: Notification Preferences (toggle switches in blue for crowd alerts, weather, price drop — stored in uiStore or local state, no backend wiring needed), Account (show email, name edit placeholder — no backend wiring needed), Privacy & Data (export data button that calls apiClient.exportData(), About section with version info). White card sections with section headings in navy.

5. Accessibility pass across all modified files: (a) In AppShell.tsx: verify bottom nav has role='tablist', each tab button has role='tab' and aria-selected. (b) All form inputs in LoginPage: ensure label htmlFor or aria-label. (c) All img tags: verify descriptive alt text (park name for park images, empty alt for decorative). (d) Loading containers: add aria-busy='true' aria-label='Loading...' on skeleton containers. (e) Error messages: add role='alert' on error state containers. (f) Skip-to-content link at top of AppShell for keyboard users: Skip to content. (g) Verify *:focus-visible outline in index.css is preserved. (h) PlanMyVisitPage progress bar: add role='progressbar' aria-valuenow aria-valuemin aria-valuemax.

6. Visual polish: (a) Verify Framer Motion initial/animate pattern on all new pages (fade-in + slide-up, delay stagger for list items). (b) Verify card hover states: white cards get hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md. (c) CTA buttons: blue buttons get active:scale-[0.97]. (d) Page transitions: AnimatePresence wrapping route outlet in AppShell. (e) Park image cards: consistent rounded-2xl overflow-hidden. (f) Section headings: consistent font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 pattern.

7. Final build verification: run full typecheck and build. Fix any remaining TypeScript errors. Common issues to check: (a) import paths for new components (ui/EmptyState etc.), (b) type assertions on apiClient responses that use 'any', (c) missing key props on list renders, (d) useEffect dependency arrays.
acceptance_criteria: TripsPage empty state shows 'No trips planned yet.' with 'Plan a Visit' CTA for authenticated users with no trips
NotificationsPage empty state shows "You're all caught up." for authenticated users with no notifications
NotificationsPage shows sign-in prompt for guest users
ProfilePage has white background with real user data
SettingsPage has white background with notification toggles and export data button
All interactive elements have accessible labels
npx vite build completes successfully with no errors
